rows.name: Custom Birthday Cake
rows.description: Personalized birthday cake with your choice of flavors, colors, and decorations. Perfect for making any birthday celebration extra special.
rows.customizationInstructions: Please specify: cake size (6", 8", 10"), flavor (vanilla, chocolate, red velvet, etc.), frosting type, color scheme, and any special decorations or messages you'd like.

rows.name: Wedding Cake
rows.description: Elegant multi-tier wedding cake designed to match your special day. We work with you to create the perfect centerpiece for your celebration.
rows.customizationInstructions: Please specify: number of tiers, serving size, flavors for each tier, frosting style, color palette, and decoration preferences. We recommend scheduling a consultation for wedding cakes.

rows.name: Themed Celebration Cake
rows.description: Custom themed cake for any celebration - from baby showers to graduations. We bring your vision to life with creative designs and delicious flavors.
rows.customizationInstructions: Please describe your theme, preferred colors, size needed, flavor preferences, and any specific design elements you'd like incorporated.

rows.name: Decorated Sugar Cookies (Dozen)
rows.description: One dozen beautifully decorated sugar cookies. Perfect for parties, gifts, or special occasions. Each cookie is hand-decorated with royal icing.
rows.customizationInstructions: Please specify: theme/design, color scheme, and any text or special details. Minimum order: 1 dozen.

rows.name: Custom Shaped Sugar Cookies
rows.description: Sugar cookies in custom shapes for your event. We can create cookies in virtually any shape to match your theme.
rows.customizationInstructions: Please describe desired shapes, colors, and design details. Custom cookie cutters may incur additional fees.
